# Country scope. The country's name is a full title (it already contains its rank word), so its long name is the
# name alone (customizable_localization/country_name_construction.txt). Not here: names that need the rank
# (BYT01 塞萨洛尼基 + 军区, chartered cities 锡耶纳 + 城邦, 金角湾 + 特许银行, freed Yuan provinces 甘肃 + rank),
# and empire-rank names whose adjective is used instead (波斯 + 帝国, 德意志 + 帝国).
oe_full_title_name = {
	OR = {
		# a naming site marks its country: the Yuan princes called by their titles (齐王 / Prince of Qi, gen_yuan_y5b.py),
		# the Wallachian protectorate and the North African expedition (author files, q5_author_marks.py)
		has_variable = oe_name_full_title
		# themes named by oe_theme_names (马其顿军区 / Theme of Macedonia, 马其顿行省, 摩里亚专制公国) and the
		# exarchates' fixed names (拉韦纳总督区); rank word 军区 / 行省 / 总督区 / 专制公国 / 督军区
		AND = {
			oe_theme_member_trigger = yes
			has_variable = oe_theme_named
			NOT = { tag = BYT01 }
			NOT = { oe_ts_charter = yes }
		}
		# Yuan branch secretariats (甘肃行省 / Gansu Branch Secretariat) until freed (then 甘肃 + rank)
		AND = {
			OR = { tag = YHN tag = YJZ tag = YJX tag = YHG tag = YSC tag = YSX tag = YGU tag = YLB tag = YLY }
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_yp_ended }
		}
		# the Great Revolution's republic (罗马共和国 / Roman Republic); the author's rank text there is a blank
		AND = { tag = BYZ has_variable = oe_gr_republican_path }
		# eastern governorates (叙利亚总督区, rank 行省) and the Moldavian governorate (摩尔达维亚总督府)
		has_variable = oe_heg_governorate
		has_variable = oe_danube_governorate_identity
		# Roman marches (高加索边疆领 / Caucasian March; the German ones are rank_kingdom)
		is_subject_type = oe_roman_march
		# German hegemony: the marches, the Kingdom of the Netherlands, the Holy Roman Empire (its adjective
		# 神圣罗马帝国 would get 帝国 again); not the unified kingdom (德意志 + 帝国)
		has_variable = oe_germany_bohemia
		has_variable = oe_germany_dutch_kingdom
		has_variable = oe_germany_dutch_march
		has_variable = oe_germany_rhine
		has_variable = oe_germany_switzerland
		has_variable = oe_germany_austria
		has_variable = oe_germany_holy_empire
		has_variable = oe_germany_bavaria
		has_variable = oe_germany_hanover
		has_variable = oe_germany_brandenburg
		# 匈牙利自治领
		is_subject_type = oe_hungarian_dominion
		# the author's Egyptian subject (埃及行省 / Province of Egypt); its rank text is empty, so the name alone is
		# what zh already showed, and English loses its stray " of "
		is_subject_type = oe_sub_mam
		# v38.0 Colonization 4.0 full-title colonial names (新西班牙总督区, 北美十三殖民地, 扶桑西岸都护府 ...):
		# prevents vanilla from appending 总督区 / 殖民地 / 伯国 a second time (zero 新西班牙总督区总督区 / 东岸殖民地联邦伯国).
		oe_col4_has_full_title_colonial_name = yes
	}
